workflow.title: Municipal Inland Wetlands & Watercourses Permitting
workflow.description: Statewide framework, municipal permitting, identification, screening, and limited federal-coordination resources for inland wetlands and watercourses projects in Connecticut.

relationships.workflow_note: Consult the controlling statewide definitions, municipal authority, regulated-activity framework, and application-review provisions.
Use for CT DEEP's current statewide program guidance, municipal implementation context, and maintained inland-wetlands resources.
Review the statewide municipal permitting framework before consulting the applicable town's regulations, forms, and procedures.
Use to identify the applicable municipal agency, then confirm current contacts and requirements directly with the municipality.
Consult for Connecticut's soil-based inland-wetland definition and statutory watercourse identification framework.
Use for preliminary mapped-soils screening without treating mapped information as a jurisdictional or field determination.
Open when evaluating whether a separate current federal aquatic-resource authorization process may also need review.
